title: String Theory
description: Every particle is a vibrating string. Unlocks the String Resonance Loom.

puzzle.goal: A relativistic string sweeps out a two-dimensional sheet X(τ, σ) in spacetime, with σ running from 0 to π along the string. Its action is minus the tension T times the area of that sheet (c = 1). Write the area element from the velocity ∂X/∂τ and the stretch ∂X/∂σ.

puzzle.ask: Small transverse wiggles of a stretched string obey the wave equation with speed √(T/μ), so its modes are f_n = (n/2L)·√(T/μ) - each mode a different 'particle'. Find the 3rd harmonic of a string of length @{L} m, tension @{T} N, density @{μ} kg/m.

vars.X: embedding of the worldsheet in spacetime

puzzle.method: The area of a surface spanned by two tangent vectors A and B is √((A·B)² − A²B²) in a Lorentzian metric (the Gram determinant); integrate it over both parameters.
